subject: electron
message: electron "30.1.0" (examples/harbor-notes/package.json:7) is major 30. Electron's support policy: "The latest three stable major versions are supported by the Electron team"; in test/fixtures/releases.json the latest stable major is 44, so the supported majors are 44, 43, 42
fix: Upgrade to Electron 44, one major at a time. The security page asks to "16. Use a current version of Electron"

subject: nodeIntegration
message: nodeIntegration: true (examples/harbor-notes/src/main.js:9) breaks item "2. Do not enable Node.js integration for remote content" of the Electron security checklist. It matters most for a window that loads remote content, which the tool cannot see
fix: Set nodeIntegration to false, or remove it; see https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/security

subject: contextIsolation
message: contextIsolation: false (examples/harbor-notes/src/main.js:10) breaks item "3. Enable Context Isolation" of the Electron security checklist. It matters most for a window that loads remote content, which the tool cannot see
fix: Set contextIsolation to true, or remove it; see https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/security

subject: publish.url
message: publish.url is http://updates.example.com/harbor-notes (examples/harbor-notes/electron-builder.yml:12): updates are fetched over plain http, so anyone on the network path can read or replace what the app downloads

subject: .pfx
message: examples/harbor-notes/build/FAKE-signing-certificate.pfx (.pfx) is a certificate or private key file inside the project. Its contents are not shown. If git tracks it, anyone with the repository has the key
fix: Remove it from the project and from the git history, revoke the certificate if it was ever pushed, and give the signing step the key from a secret store or an environment variable

subject: windows signing
message: No Windows code signing is configured (electron-builder). electron-builder also signs with a certificate from the WIN_CSC_LINK or CSC_LINK environment variable, which the files cannot show. Microsoft's code signing page says signing consecutive releases "with a consistent publisher/signing identity lets publisher reputation build over time", which an unsigned app cannot do (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/package-and-deploy/code-signing-options)
fix: Set win.sign with a type of signtool, hsm, pkcs11 or azure

subject: notarization
message: Notarization is not enabled in examples/harbor-notes/electron-builder.yml:5 (mac.notarize). Apple's notarization page (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/notarizing-macos-software-before-distribution): "Notarize your macOS software to give users more confidence that the Developer ID-signed software you distribute has been checked by Apple for malicious components"
fix: Set mac.notarize to true and give the Apple credentials as environment variables (docs/rules-and-sources.md)
